text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, this officer thought she heard a 
voice calling from this direction...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
There's no one else here, so it's all 
right. Please feel safe to come out!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...No response. Where in the world could 
they be hiding?"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
O Three Goddesses... Did you happen to see 
anything?
